gText_ForPetesSake.from:
OAK: Oh, for Pete's sake…
So pushy, as always.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\pYou've never had a POKéMON battle
before, have you?\pA POKéMON battle is when TRAINERS
pit their POKéMON against each\lother.\p

OAK: Oh, pero bueno…
Tan agresivo como siempre.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\p¿Nunca has tenido una batalla
POKéMON antes, cierto?\pUna batalla POKéMON es cuando los
ENTRENADORES enfrentan a sus\lPOKéMON entre sí.\p

gText_OakNoRunningFromATrainer.from: OAK: No! There's no running away\nfrom a TRAINER POKéMON battle!\p
gText_OakNoRunningFromATrainer.to: OAK: ¡No! ¡No hay escape de una\nbatalla entre ENTRENADORES!\p

gText_WinEarnsPrizeMoney.from: OAK: Hm! Excellent!\pIf you win, you earn prize money,\nand your POKéMON will grow!\pBattle other TRAINERS and make\nyour POKéMON strong!\p
gText_WinEarnsPrizeMoney.to: OAK: ¡Hm! ¡Excelente!\p¡Si ganas, obtendrás dinero, y tus\nPOKéMON crecerán!\p¡Lucha con otros ENTRENADORES y\nhaz fuertes a tus POKéMON!\p

gText_HowDissapointing.from:
OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p
gText_HowDissapointing.to:
OAK: Hm…
Qué decepcionante…\pSi ganas, obtendrás dinero, y tus
POKéMON crecerán.\pPero si pierdes, {B_PLAYER_NAME},
tendrás que pagar dinero…\pSin embargo, cómo esta vez no lo
sabías, pagaré por ti.\pPero las cosas no serán así cuando
estés fuera de estas puertas.\pPor eso debes luchar con POKéMON
salvajes para hacerte más fuerte.\p

gMoveDescription_IcePunch.from:
The foe is punched

foe frozen.

gMoveDescription_ThunderPunch.from:
The foe is punched

gMoveDescription_Scratch.from: Hard, pointed, and\nsharp claws rake\nthe foe.

Ataque con pinzas

ataca al siguiente.

crítico.

gMoveDescription_SwordsDance.from:
A frenetic dance of
fighting. It sharply
raises the ATTACK
stat.

A basic attack.

cut down thin trees
and grass.

Strikes the foe
with a gust of wind
whipped up by
wings.

gMoveDescription_WingAttack.from: The foe is struck\nwith large, imposing\nwings spread wide.

gMoveDescription_Whirlwind.from:
The foe is made to
switch out with an
ally. In the wild,
the battle ends.

A 2-turn move that
hits on the 2nd
turn. Use it to fly

tentacles are used
to bind the foe for
two to five turns.

gMoveDescription_Slam.from: The foe is struck\nwith a long tail,\nvines, etc.

gMoveDescription_Stomp.from:
The foe is stomped

foe flinch.

gMoveDescription_DoubleKick.from:
Two legs are used
to quickly kick the
foe twice in one
turn.

gMoveDescription_MegaKick.from:
The foe is attacked
by a kick fired
with muscle-packed
power.

high, then kicks.

user hurts itself.

rolling spin.

foe flinch.

face, reducing its

gMoveDescription_Headbutt.from:

head out and rams.

foe flinch.

Lanza un potente
cabezazo que puede

pointed horn to

horn or beak two to
five times.

gMoveDescription_Tackle.from:

gMoveDescription_BodySlam.from:

full body on the
foe. It may leave
the foe paralyzed.

objetivo con todo

paralizar.

gMoveDescription_Wrap.from:

vines are used to
wrap the foe for

gMoveDescription_TakeDown.from:

body charge attack

user a little.

about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused.

turnos y acaba

agresor.

gMoveDescription_DoubleEdge.from:

risking tackle that

a little.

gMoveDescription_TailWhip.from:

tail cutely, making
the foe lower its

HP damage.
gMoveDescription_SonicBoom.to: Lanza ondas de\nchoque que restan\n20 PS al objetivo.

gMoveDescription_Disable.from:
For a few turns,
it prevents the foe
from using the move
it last used.
gMoveDescription_Disable.to:
Impide usar el
último movimiento
rival de 2 a 5
turnos.

gMoveDescription_Acid.from:
The foe is sprayed
with a harsh, hide-
melting acid that
may lower DEFENSE.
gMoveDescription_Acid.to: Rocía ácido. Puede\nbajar la Defensa\ndel rival.

gMoveDescription_Ember.from:
The foe is attacked
with small flames.
The foe may suffer
a burn.

gMoveDescription_Flamethrower.from:
The foe is scorched
with intense flames.
The foe may suffer
a burn.
gMoveDescription_Flamethrower.to:
Ataca con una gran
ráfaga de fuego
que puede causar
quemaduras.

gMoveDescription_Mist.from:
The ally party is
protected by a
mist that prevents
stat reductions.
gMoveDescription_Mist.to:
Protege al equipo
de las bajadas de
estadísticas por
cinco turnos.

gMoveDescription_WaterGun.from:
The foe is struck
with a lot of water
expelled forcibly
from the mouth.

gMoveDescription_HydroPump.from:
A high volume of
water is blasted at
the foe under great
pressure.
gMoveDescription_HydroPump.to: Lanza una gran masa\nde agua a presión\npara atacar.

gMoveDescription_Surf.from:
A big wave crashes
down on the foe.
Can also be used
for crossing water.
gMoveDescription_Surf.to: Ataca a los rivales\ncon una gran ola de\nagua.

gMoveDescription_IceBeam.from:
The foe is struck
with an icy beam.
It may freeze the
foe solid.
gMoveDescription_IceBeam.to: Rayo de hielo que\npuede llegar a\ncongelar.

gMoveDescription_Blizzard.from:
The foe is blasted
with a blizzard.
It may freeze the
foe solid.
gMoveDescription_Blizzard.to: Tormenta de hielo\nque puede llegar a\ncongelar.

gMoveDescription_Psybeam.from:
A peculiar ray is
shot at the foe.
It may leave the
foe confused.

gMoveDescription_BubbleBeam.from:
A spray of bubbles
strikes the foe.
It may lower the
foe's SPEED stat.
gMoveDescription_BubbleBeam.to: Diluvio de burbujas\nque puede bajar la\nVelocidad.

gMoveDescription_AuroraBeam.from:
A rainbow-colored
attack beam.
It may lower the
foe's ATTACK stat.

gMoveDescription_HyperBeam.from:
A severely damaging
attack that makes
the user rest on
the next turn.
gMoveDescription_HyperBeam.to:
Es eficaz, pero el
atacante deberá
descansar en el
siguiente turno.

gMoveDescription_Peck.from:
The foe is jabbed
with a sharply
pointed beak or
horn.
gMoveDescription_Peck.to: Ensarta al objetivo\ncon un cuerno o\npico punzante.

gMoveDescription_DrillPeck.from:
A corkscrewing
attack with the
sharp beak acting
as a drill.

gMoveDescription_Submission.from:
A reckless, full-
body throw attack
that also hurts the
user a little.
gMoveDescription_Submission.to: Tira al objetivo al\nsuelo. También\nhiere al agresor.

gMoveDescription_LowKick.from:
A low, tripping kick
that inflicts more
damage on heavier
foes.
gMoveDescription_LowKick.to:
Patada baja. Cuanto
más pesa el
objetivo, más daño
causa.

gMoveDescription_Counter.from:
A retaliation move
that counters any
physical hit with
double the damage.

gMoveDescription_SeismicToss.from:
A gravity-fed throw
that causes damage
matching the user's
level.
gMoveDescription_SeismicToss.to: Causa tanto daño\ncomo el nivel de\nquien lo usa.

gMoveDescription_Strength.from:
The foe is slugged
at maximum power.
Can also be used
to move boulders.
gMoveDescription_Strength.to:
Potente puñetazo.
Fuera de combate
sirve para mover
rocas.

gMoveDescription_Absorb.from:
An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
gMoveDescription_Absorb.to: Recupera la mitad\ndel daño causado\nal rival.

gMoveDescription_MegaDrain.from:
A tough attack that
drains half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
gMoveDescription_MegaDrain.to: Recupera la mitad\ndel daño causado\nal rival.

gMoveDescription_LeechSeed.from:
A seed is planted
on the foe to steal
some HP for the 
user on every turn.
gMoveDescription_LeechSeed.to:
Planta semillas que
absorben PS del
rival en cada
turno.

gMoveDescription_Growth.from:
The user's body is
forced to grow,
raising the SP.
ATK stat.
gMoveDescription_Growth.to: Aumenta el Ataque\nEspecial de quien\nlo usa.

gMoveDescription_RazorLeaf.from:
The foe is hit with
a cutting leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.

gMoveDescription_SolarBeam.from:
A 2-turn move that
blasts the foe with
absorbed energy in
the 2nd turn.
gMoveDescription_SolarBeam.to:
Absorbe luz un
turno y ataca con
un rayo al
siguiente.

gMoveDescription_PoisonPowder.from:
A cloud of toxic
dust is scattered.
It may poison the
foe.

gMoveDescription_StunSpore.from:
Paralyzing dust is
scattered wildly.
It may paralyze
the foe.

gMoveDescription_SleepPowder.from:
A sleep-inducing
dust is scattered
in high volume
around a foe.

gMoveDescription_PetalDance.from:
The user attacks
with petals for two
to three turns,
then gets confused.
gMoveDescription_PetalDance.to:
Lanza pétalos de
dos a tres turnos y
acaba confundiendo
al atacante.

gMoveDescription_StringShot.from:
The foe is bound
with strings shot
from the mouth to
reduce its SPEED.
gMoveDescription_StringShot.to: Lanza hilos de seda\ny baja la Velocidad\nde los rivales.

gMoveDescription_DragonRage.from:
The foe is hit with
a shock wave that
always inflicts 40-
HP damage.
gMoveDescription_DragonRage.to: Ráfaga de furiosas\nondas de choque\nque quitan 40 PS.

gMoveDescription_FireSpin.from:
The foe is trapped
in an intense spiral
of fire that rages
two to five turns.
gMoveDescription_FireSpin.to: Atrapa al rival en\nfuego durante 2 a 5\nturnos.

gMoveDescription_ThunderShock.from:
An electric shock
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed.

gMoveDescription_Thunderbolt.from:
A strong electrical
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed.

gMoveDescription_ThunderWave.from:
A weak electric
shock that is sure
to cause paralysis
if it hits.
gMoveDescription_ThunderWave.to:
Una ligera descarga
que paraliza al
objetivo si lo
alcanza.

gMoveDescription_Thunder.from:
A brutal lightning
attack that may
also leave the foe
paralyzed.
gMoveDescription_Thunder.to:
Un poderoso rayo
que daña al
objetivo y puede
paralizarlo.

gMoveDescription_RockThrow.from:
The foe is attacked
with a shower of
small, easily
thrown rocks.

gMoveDescription_Earthquake.from:
An earthquake that
strikes all POKéMON
in battle excluding
the user.
gMoveDescription_Earthquake.to:
Provoca un
terremoto que
golpea a todos los
demás Pokémon.

gMoveDescription_Fissure.from:
The foe is dropped
into a fissure.
The foe faints if it
hits.
gMoveDescription_Fissure.to: Abre una grieta que\ndebilita al rival de\nun solo golpe.

gMoveDescription_Dig.from:
An attack that hits
on the 2nd turn.
Can also be used
to exit dungeons.
gMoveDescription_Dig.to: Cava un turno y\nataca al siguiente.

gMoveDescription_Toxic.from:
A move that badly
poisons the foe.
Its poison damage
worsens every turn.
gMoveDescription_Toxic.to:
Envenena gravemente
al objetivo y causa
un daño mayor en
cada turno.

gMoveDescription_Confusion.from:
A weak telekinetic
attack that may
also leave the foe
confused.

gMoveDescription_Psychic.from:
A strong telekinetic
attack. It may also
lower the foe's
SP. DEF stat.
gMoveDescription_Psychic.to: Ataque psíquico que\npuede bajar la\nDefensa Especial.

gMoveDescription_Hypnosis.from:
Hypnotic suggestion
is used to make the
foe fall into a
deep sleep.

gMoveDescription_Meditate.from:
The user meditates
to awaken its power
and raise its
ATTACK stat.
gMoveDescription_Meditate.to:
El usuario reposa y
medita para
potenciar el
Ataque.

gMoveDescription_Agility.from:
The user relaxes
and lightens its
body to sharply
boost its SPEED.

gMoveDescription_QuickAttack.from:
An almost invisibly
fast attack that
is certain to strike
first.
gMoveDescription_QuickAttack.to: Ataque rápido que\npermite golpear en\nprimer lugar.

gMoveDescription_Rage.from:
An attack that
becomes stronger
each time the user
is hit in battle.
gMoveDescription_Rage.to:
Al usarse, aumenta
el Ataque del
usuario cada vez
que es golpeado.

gMoveDescription_Teleport.from:
Use it to flee from
any wild POKéMON.
Also warps to the
last POKé CENTER.
gMoveDescription_Teleport.to: Permite huir de una\nbatalla contra un\nPokémon salvaje.

gMoveDescription_NightShade.from:
An attack with a
mirage that inflicts
damage matching
the user's level.
gMoveDescription_NightShade.to: Causa tanto daño\ncomo el nivel de\nquien lo usa.

gMoveDescription_Mimic.from:
The user copies the
move last used by
the foe for the
rest of the battle.
gMoveDescription_Mimic.to: Copia el último\nmovimiento usado\npor el rival.

gMoveDescription_Screech.from:
An ear-splitting
screech is emitted
to sharply reduce
the foe's DEFENSE.
gMoveDescription_Screech.to:
Alarido agudo que
reduce mucho la
Defensa del
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_DoubleTeam.from:
The user creates
illusory copies of
itself to raise its
evasiveness.
gMoveDescription_DoubleTeam.to: Crea copias de sí\nmismo para mejorar\nla Evasión.

gMoveDescription_Recover.from:
A self-healing move
that restores HP by
up to half of the
user's maximum HP.
gMoveDescription_Recover.to: Restaura hasta la\nmitad de los PS\nmáximos.

gMoveDescription_Harden.from:
The user stiffens
all the muscles in
its body to raise
its DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_Harden.to: Tensa los músculos\npara subir la\nDefensa propia.

gMoveDescription_Minimize.from:
The user compresses
all the cells in its
body to raise its
evasiveness.

gMoveDescription_Smokescreen.from:
An obscuring cloud
of smoke or ink
reduces the foe's
accuracy.
gMoveDescription_Smokescreen.to:
Baja la Precisión
del objetivo con
una nube de humo o
tinta.

gMoveDescription_ConfuseRay.from:
The foe is exposed
to a sinister ray
that triggers
confusion.

gMoveDescription_Withdraw.from:
The user withdraws
its body in its hard
shell, raising its
DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_Withdraw.to:
El usuario se
protege en su
coraza y sube la
Defensa.

gMoveDescription_DefenseCurl.from:
The user curls up
to conceal weak
spots and raise its
DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_DefenseCurl.to:
Se enrosca para
ocultar su punto
débil. Sube la
Defensa.

gMoveDescription_Barrier.from:
The user creates a
sturdy wall that
sharply raises its
DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_Barrier.to: Crea una barrera\nque aumenta mucho\nla Defensa.

gMoveDescription_LightScreen.from:
A wall of light
cuts damage from
SP. ATK attacks
for five turns.
gMoveDescription_LightScreen.to: Reduce el daño de\nataques especiales\npor cinco turnos.

gMoveDescription_Haze.from:
Eliminates all stat
changes among all
POKéMON engaged in
battle.
gMoveDescription_Haze.to: Elimina los cambios\nde estadísticas de\ntodos los Pokémon.

gMoveDescription_Reflect.from:
A wall of light
cuts damage from
physical attacks
for five turns.
gMoveDescription_Reflect.to: Reduce el daño de\nataques físicos por\ncinco turnos.

gMoveDescription_FocusEnergy.from:
The user takes a
deep breath and
focuses to raise its
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_FocusEnergy.to:
Concentra energía
para aumentar las
posibilidades de un
golpe crítico.

gMoveDescription_Bide.from:
The user endures
attacks for two
turns, then strikes
back double.
gMoveDescription_Bide.to:
Espera dos turnos
para atacar con el
doble de potencia
del daño recibido.

gMoveDescription_Metronome.from:
Waggles a finger
and stimulates the
brain into using any
move at random.
gMoveDescription_Metronome.to:
Usa al azar un
movimiento de entre
casi todos los
existentes.

gMoveDescription_MirrorMove.from:
The user counters
the move last used
by the foe with the
same move.
gMoveDescription_MirrorMove.to:
Contraataca con el
mismo movimiento
empleado por el
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_SelfDestruct.from:
The user blows up
to inflict severe
damage, even
making itself faint.
gMoveDescription_SelfDestruct.to:
Explota para dañar
a los demás y se
debilita quien lo
usa.

gMoveDescription_EggBomb.from:
A large egg is
hurled with great
force at the foe to
inflict damage.
gMoveDescription_EggBomb.to: Arroja un huevo al\nobjetivo con gran\nfuerza.

gMoveDescription_Lick.from:
The foe is licked
and hit with a long
tongue. It may
also paralyze.
gMoveDescription_Lick.to: Una lengua ataca al\nobjetivo. Puede\ncausar parálisis.

gMoveDescription_Smog.from:
The foe is attacked
with exhaust gases.
It may also poison
the foe.
gMoveDescription_Smog.to:
El objetivo es
atacado con gases
tóxicos que pueden
llegar a envenenar.

gMoveDescription_Sludge.from:
Toxic sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target.
gMoveDescription_Sludge.to: Arroja residuos al\nobjetivo. Puede\nllegar a envenenar.

gMoveDescription_BoneClub.from:
The foe is clubbed
with a bone held in
hand. It may make
the foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_BoneClub.to:
Aporrea con un
hueso. Puede hacer
retroceder al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_FireBlast.from:
The foe is hit with
an intense flame.
It may leave the
target with a burn.
gMoveDescription_FireBlast.to: Llama intensa que\nchamusca y puede\ncausar quemaduras.

gMoveDescription_Waterfall.from:
A powerful charge
attack. It can also
be used to climb
a waterfall.

gMoveDescription_Clamp.from:
The foe is clamped
and squeezed by
the user's shell for
two to five turns.
gMoveDescription_Clamp.to: Atrapa al rival con\nuna concha durante\n2 a 5 turnos.

gMoveDescription_Swift.from:
Star-shaped rays
that never miss are
fired at all foes in
battle.
gMoveDescription_Swift.to:
Lanza rayos en
forma de estrella
que no fallan
nunca.

gMoveDescription_SkullBash.from:
The user raises its
DEFENSE in the 1st
turn, then attacks
in the 2nd turn.
gMoveDescription_SkullBash.to: Sube la Defensa un\nturno y golpea al\nsiguiente.

gMoveDescription_SpikeCannon.from:
Sharp spikes are
fired at the foe to
strike two to five
times.
gMoveDescription_SpikeCannon.to: Lanza finas púas\nque hieren de dos a\ncinco veces.

gMoveDescription_Constrict.from:
The foe is attacked
with long tentacles
or vines. It may
lower SPEED.
gMoveDescription_Constrict.to: Constriñe para herir\ny puede bajar la\nVelocidad.

gMoveDescription_Amnesia.to:
El usuario olvida
sus preocupaciones
y aumenta mucho la
Defensa Especial.

gMoveDescription_Kinesis.from:
The user distracts
the foe by bending
a spoon. It may
lower accuracy.
gMoveDescription_Kinesis.to:
Dobla una cuchara
para distraer al
objetivo y bajar su
nivel de Precisión.

gMoveDescription_SoftBoiled.from:
Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally.
gMoveDescription_SoftBoiled.to: Recupera hasta la\nmitad de los PS\nmáximos.

gMoveDescription_HiJumpKick.from:
A strong jumping
knee kick. If it
misses, the user is
hurt.
gMoveDescription_HiJumpKick.to:
Salta muy alto y
lanza una patada.
Si falla, dañará al
usuario.

gMoveDescription_Glare.from:
The user intimidates
the foe with the
design on its belly
to cause paralysis.
gMoveDescription_Glare.to:
Intimida y asusta al
objetivo con la
mirada para dejarlo
paralizado.

gMoveDescription_DreamEater.from:
Absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
on a sleeping foe
to restore HP.
gMoveDescription_DreamEater.to:
Restaura al usuario
la mitad del daño
causado a un
objetivo dormido.

gMoveDescription_PoisonGas.from:
The foe is sprayed
with a cloud of
toxic gas that may
poison the foe.
gMoveDescription_PoisonGas.to:
Lanza una nube de
gas tóxico a los
rivales. Produce
envenenamiento.

gMoveDescription_Barrage.from:
Round objects are
hurled at the foe
to strike two to
five times.
gMoveDescription_Barrage.to:
Arroja esferas al
objetivo entre dos
y cinco veces
seguidas.

gMoveDescription_LeechLife.from:
An attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
gMoveDescription_LeechLife.to:
Restaura al usuario
la mitad del daño
causado al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_LovelyKiss.from:
The user forces a
kiss on the foe
with a scary face
that induces sleep.
gMoveDescription_LovelyKiss.to:
Con una cara que
asusta, da un beso
al objetivo y lo
adormece.

gMoveDescription_SkyAttack.from:
A 2nd-turn attack
move with a high
critical-hit ratio.
The foe may flinch.
gMoveDescription_SkyAttack.to:
Carga un turno y
ataca al siguiente.
Puede hacer
retroceder.

gMoveDescription_Transform.from:
The user transforms
into a copy of the
foe with even the
same move set.
gMoveDescription_Transform.to: Copia la apariencia\ny los movimientos\ndel rival.

gMoveDescription_Bubble.from:
A spray of bubbles
hits the foe.
It may lower the
foe's SPEED stat.
gMoveDescription_Bubble.to:
Lanza burbujas a
los contrincantes y
puede reducir su
Velocidad.

gMoveDescription_DizzyPunch.from:
The foe is hit with
a rhythmic punch
that may leave it
confused.

gMoveDescription_Spore.from:
The user scatters
bursts of fine
spores that induce
sleep.

gMoveDescription_Flash.from:
A blast of light
that cuts the foe's
accuracy. It also
illuminates caves.
gMoveDescription_Flash.to: Luz cegadora que\nbaja la Precisión\ndel objetivo.

gMoveDescription_Psywave.from:
The foe is attacked
with an odd, hot
energy wave that
varies in intensity.
gMoveDescription_Psywave.to: Ataque con una onda\nde energía de\nintensidad variable.

gMoveDescription_Splash.from:
The user just flops
and splashes around
without having any
effect.

gMoveDescription_AcidArmor.from:
The user alters its
cells to liquefy
itself and sharply
raise DEFENSE.
gMoveDescription_AcidArmor.to: Sube mucho la\nDefensa al licuar\nel cuerpo.

gMoveDescription_Crabhammer.from:
A large pincer is
used to hammer the
foe. It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_Crabhammer.to:
Golpea con fuerza
con una pinza
enorme. Suele ser
crítico.

gMoveDescription_Explosion.from:
The user explodes
to inflict terrible
damage even while
fainting itself.
gMoveDescription_Explosion.to:
Explota con gran
fuerza y se
debilita quien lo
usa.

gMoveDescription_FurySwipes.from:
The foe is raked
with sharp claws or
scythes two to five
times.

gMoveDescription_Bonemerang.from:
The user throws a
bone that hits the
foe once, then once
again on return.
gMoveDescription_Bonemerang.to:
Lanza un hueso a
modo de bumerán
que golpea dos
veces.

gMoveDescription_Rest.from:
The user sleeps for
two turns to fully
restore HP and heal
any status problem.
gMoveDescription_Rest.to: Duerme dos turnos y\nrecupera todos los\nPS y el estado.

gMoveDescription_RockSlide.from:
Large boulders are
hurled at the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_RockSlide.to:
Lanza grandes
pedruscos. Puede
hacer retroceder a
los rivales.

gMoveDescription_HyperFang.from:
The foe is attacked
with sharp fangs.
It may make the
foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_HyperFang.to:
Ataque con finos
colmillos. Puede
hacer retroceder al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_Sharpen.from:
The user reduces
its polygon count
to sharpen edges
and raise ATTACK.
gMoveDescription_Sharpen.to:
El perfil del
usuario se hace más
afilado y su Ataque
mejora.

gMoveDescription_Conversion.from:
The user changes
its type to match
the type of one of
its moves.
gMoveDescription_Conversion.to:
Cambia el tipo del
usuario por el del
primero de sus
movimientos.

gMoveDescription_TriAttack.from:
A simultaneous
3-beam attack that
may paralyze, burn,
or freeze the foe.
gMoveDescription_TriAttack.to:
Ataque triple que
puede paralizar,
quemar o congelar
al objetivo.

gMoveDescription_SuperFang.from:
The user attacks
with sharp fangs
and halves the
foe's HP.
gMoveDescription_SuperFang.to:
Finos colmillos que
reducen a la mitad
los PS del
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_Slash.from:
The foe is slashed
with claws, etc.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_Slash.to:
Ataca con cuchillas
o con pinzas. Suele
dar un golpe
crítico.

gMoveDescription_Substitute.from:
The user creates a
decoy using one-
quarter of its full
HP.
gMoveDescription_Substitute.to:
Crea un sustituto
usando una cuarta
parte de sus PS
máximos.

gMoveDescription_Struggle.from:
An attack that is
used only if there
is no PP. It also
hurts the user.
gMoveDescription_Struggle.to:
Ataque desesperado
sin PP. También
hiere a quien lo
usa.

gMoveDescription_Sketch.from:
This move copies
the move last used
by the foe, then
disappears.
gMoveDescription_Sketch.to: Copia para siempre\nel último movimiento\nusado por el rival.

gMoveDescription_TripleKick.from:
A 3-kick attack
that becomes more
powerful with each
successive hit.
gMoveDescription_TripleKick.to:
Patea hasta tres
veces seguidas y
cada vez más
fuerte.

gMoveDescription_Thief.from:
An attack that may
take the foe's held
item if the user
isn't holding one.
gMoveDescription_Thief.to: Ataca y roba el\nobjeto del rival si\nno se lleva ninguno.

gMoveDescription_SpiderWeb.from:
Ensnares the foe 
with sticky string
so it doesn't flee
or switch out.
gMoveDescription_SpiderWeb.to:
Enreda al objetivo
para evitar que
abandone la
batalla.

gMoveDescription_MindReader.from:
The user predicts
the foe's action to
ensure its next
attack hits.

gMoveDescription_Nightmare.from:
A sleeping foe is
shown a nightmare
that inflicts some
damage every turn.
gMoveDescription_Nightmare.to:
El objetivo dormido
sufre una pesadilla
que le hace perder
PS en cada turno.

gMoveDescription_FlameWheel.from:
The user makes a
fiery charge at the
foe. It may cause
a burn.

gMoveDescription_Snore.from:
An attack that can
be used only while
asleep. It may
cause flinching.
gMoveDescription_Snore.to: Solo se usa al\ndormir. Puede hacer\nretroceder al rival.

gMoveDescription_Curse.from:
A move that works
differently for the
GHOST-type and all
the other types.
gMoveDescription_Curse.to: El efecto cambia si\nquien lo usa es de\ntipo Fantasma.

gMoveDescription_Flail.from:
A desperate attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.
gMoveDescription_Flail.to:
Ataque frenético.
Cuantos menos PS
tenga el usuario,
más daño producirá.

gMoveDescription_Conversion2.from:
The user changes
type to make itself
resistant to the
last attack it took.
gMoveDescription_Conversion2.to:
Cambia a un tipo
que resista el
último ataque
recibido.

gMoveDescription_Aeroblast.from:
A vortex of air is
shot at the foe.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_Aeroblast.to: Lanza un chorro de\naire que suele dar\nun golpe crítico.

gMoveDescription_CottonSpore.from:
Cotton-like spores
cling to the foe,
sharply reducing
its SPEED stat.
gMoveDescription_CottonSpore.to:
Adhiere esporas a
los rivales para
reducir mucho su
Velocidad.

gMoveDescription_Reversal.from:
An all-out attack
that becomes more
powerful the less
HP the user has.
gMoveDescription_Reversal.to:
Ataque desesperado
que causa más daño
cuantos menos PS
tenga el usuario.

gMoveDescription_Spite.from:
A move that cuts
2 to 5 PP from the
move last used by
the foe.
gMoveDescription_Spite.to: Reduce los PP del\núltimo movimiento\nusado por el rival.

gMoveDescription_PowderSnow.from:
Blasts the foe with
a snowy gust.
It may cause
freezing.

gMoveDescription_Protect.from:
Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession.
gMoveDescription_Protect.to:
Frena todos los
ataques, pero puede
fallar si se usa
repetidamente.

gMoveDescription_MachPunch.from:
A punch thrown at
blinding speed.
It is certain to
strike first.
gMoveDescription_MachPunch.to: Puñetazo que se da\nrápido para golpear\nprimero.

gMoveDescription_ScaryFace.from:
Frightens the foe
with a scary face
to sharply reduce
its SPEED.
gMoveDescription_ScaryFace.to: Asusta al objetivo\npara reducir mucho\nsu Velocidad.

gMoveDescription_FaintAttack.from:
The user draws up
close to the foe
disarmingly, then
hits without fail.
gMoveDescription_FaintAttack.to:
Engaña al objetivo
para acercarse y
dar un puñetazo
que no falla.

gMoveDescription_SweetKiss.from:
The user kisses
the foe with sweet
cuteness that
causes confusion.
gMoveDescription_SweetKiss.to: Da un beso con tal\ndulzura que causa\nconfusión.

gMoveDescription_BellyDrum.from:
The user maximizes
its ATTACK stat at
the cost of half
its full HP.
gMoveDescription_BellyDrum.to:
Reduce la mitad de
los PS máximos para
mejorar al máximo
el Ataque.

gMoveDescription_SludgeBomb.from:
Filthy sludge is
hurled at the foe.
It may poison the
target.
gMoveDescription_SludgeBomb.to: Arroja residuos al\nobjetivo. Puede\nllegar a envenenar.

gMoveDescription_MudSlap.from:
Mud is hurled in
the foe's face to
inflict damage and
lower its accuracy.
gMoveDescription_MudSlap.to: Echa lodo en la\ncara para bajar la\nPrecisión.

gMoveDescription_Octazooka.from:
Ink is blasted in
the foe's face or
eyes to damage and
lower accuracy.
gMoveDescription_Octazooka.to: Dispara tinta a la\ncara. Puede bajar\nla Precisión.

gMoveDescription_Spikes.from:
A trap of spikes is
laid around the
foe's party to hurt
foes switching in.
gMoveDescription_Spikes.to: Esparce púas que\ndañan a los rivales\ncuando entran.

gMoveDescription_ZapCannon.from:
An electric blast is
fired like a cannon
to inflict damage
and paralyze.
gMoveDescription_ZapCannon.to:
Dispara una
descarga eléctrica
que causa daño y
parálisis.

gMoveDescription_Foresight.from:
Completely negates
the foe's efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade.
gMoveDescription_Foresight.to: Anula la evasión y\npermite golpear a\nlos Fantasma.

gMoveDescription_DestinyBond.from:
If the user faints,
the foe delivering
the final hit also
faints.
gMoveDescription_DestinyBond.to: Si el rival debilita\na quien lo usa,\ntambién se debilita.

gMoveDescription_PerishSong.from:
Any battler that
hears this faints
in three turns
unless it switches.
gMoveDescription_PerishSong.to:
Quienes lo oigan se
debilitarán en tres
turnos si no
cambian.

gMoveDescription_IcyWind.from:
A chilling wind is
used to attack.
It also lowers the
SPEED stat.
gMoveDescription_IcyWind.to:
Ataque con aire
helado que baja la
Velocidad de los
rivales.

gMoveDescription_Detect.from:
Enables the user to
evade all attacks.
It may fail if used
in succession.
gMoveDescription_Detect.to:
Frena todos los
ataques, pero puede
fallar si se usa
repetidamente.

gMoveDescription_BoneRush.from:
The user strikes
the foe with a bone
in hand two to five
times.
gMoveDescription_BoneRush.to:
Hueso en ristre,
aporrea al objetivo
de dos a cinco
veces.

gMoveDescription_LockOn.from:
The user locks on
to the foe, making
the next move sure
to hit.
gMoveDescription_LockOn.to: Fija el blanco para\nque el siguiente\nataque no falle.

gMoveDescription_Outrage.from:
The user thrashes
about for two to
three turns, then
becomes confused.
gMoveDescription_Outrage.to:
Ataca de dos a tres
turnos y acaba
confundiendo al
agresor.

gMoveDescription_Sandstorm.from:
A 5-turn sandstorm
that damages all
types except ROCK,
GROUND, and STEEL.
gMoveDescription_Sandstorm.to:
Tormenta de cinco
turnos. No daña a
Roca, Tierra ni
Acero.

gMoveDescription_GigaDrain.from:
A harsh attack that
absorbs half the
damage it inflicted
to restore HP.
gMoveDescription_GigaDrain.to: Recupera la mitad\ndel daño causado\nal rival.

gMoveDescription_Endure.from:
The user endures
any hit with 1 HP
left. It may fail if
used in succession.
gMoveDescription_Endure.to:
Resiste cualquier
ataque de este
turno con al menos
1 PS.

gMoveDescription_Charm.from:
The foe is charmed
by the user's cute
appeals, sharply
cutting its ATTACK.
gMoveDescription_Charm.to: Engatusa al\nobjetivo y reduce\nbastante su Ataque.

gMoveDescription_Rollout.from:
A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it hits.
gMoveDescription_Rollout.to: Ataca cinco turnos\nseguidos. Su fuerza\naumenta cada vez.

gMoveDescription_FalseSwipe.from:
A restrained attack
that always leaves
the foe with at
least 1 HP.
gMoveDescription_FalseSwipe.to:
Ataque moderado
que no debilita al
objetivo y le deja
al menos 1 PS.

gMoveDescription_Swagger.from:
A move that makes
the foe confused,
but also sharply
raises its ATTACK.
gMoveDescription_Swagger.to:
Provoca confusión
en el objetivo,
pero también sube
mucho su Ataque.

gMoveDescription_MilkDrink.from:
Heals the user by
up to half its full
HP. It can be used
to heal an ally.
gMoveDescription_MilkDrink.to: Recupera hasta la\nmitad de los PS\nmáximos.

gMoveDescription_Spark.from:
An electrically
charged tackle that
may also paralyze
the foe.

gMoveDescription_FuryCutter.from:
An attack that
grows stronger on
each successive
hit.
gMoveDescription_FuryCutter.to:
Corta con más
fuerza cada vez
que acierta
consecutivamente.

gMoveDescription_SteelWing.from:
The foe is hit with
wings of steel.
It may also raise
the user's DEFENSE.
gMoveDescription_SteelWing.to: Golpea con alas de\nacero. Puede subir\nla Defensa propia.

gMoveDescription_MeanLook.from:
The foe is fixed
with a mean look
that prevents it
from escaping.
gMoveDescription_MeanLook.to: Mal de ojo que\nimpide al objetivo\nhuir de la batalla.

gMoveDescription_Attract.from:
If it is the other
gender, the foe is
made infatuated and
unlikely to attack.
gMoveDescription_Attract.to:
Enamora al rival
del género opuesto
y dificulta sus
ataques.

gMoveDescription_SleepTalk.from:
While asleep, the
user randomly uses
one of the moves it
knows.
gMoveDescription_SleepTalk.to:
Mientras duerme,
usa uno de sus
movimientos elegido
al azar.

gMoveDescription_HealBell.from:
A soothing bell
chimes to heal the
status problems of
all allies.
gMoveDescription_HealBell.to:
Tañido que cura los
problemas de estado
de todos los
Pokémon del equipo.

gMoveDescription_Return.from:
This attack move
grows more powerful
the more the user
likes its TRAINER.
gMoveDescription_Return.to:
Hace más daño
cuanto mayor es la
amistad con quien
lo usa.

gMoveDescription_Present.from:
The foe is given a
booby-trapped gift.
It restores HP
sometimes, however.
gMoveDescription_Present.to:
Entrega un regalo
que puede causar
daño o recuperar
PS.

gMoveDescription_Frustration.from:
This attack move
grows more powerful
the less the user
likes its TRAINER.
gMoveDescription_Frustration.to:
Hace más daño
cuanto menor es la
amistad con quien
lo usa.

gMoveDescription_Safeguard.from:
It protects the
user's party from
all status problems
for five turns.
gMoveDescription_Safeguard.to:
Protege al equipo
de problemas de
estado por cinco
turnos.

gMoveDescription_PainSplit.from:
The user adds its
HP to the foe's HP,
then equally shares
the total HP.
gMoveDescription_PainSplit.to: Suma los PS propios\ny del rival y los\nreparte por igual.

gMoveDescription_SacredFire.from:
A mystical and
powerful fire
attack that may
inflict a burn.
gMoveDescription_SacredFire.to:
Fuego místico de
gran intensidad que
puede causar
quemaduras.

gMoveDescription_Magnitude.from:
A ground-shaking
attack against all
standing POKéMON.
Its power varies.
gMoveDescription_Magnitude.to: Sacude la tierra\ncon una fuerza que\nvaría en cada uso.

gMoveDescription_DynamicPunch.from:
The foe is punched
with the user's full
power. It confuses
the foe if it hits.
gMoveDescription_DynamicPunch.to:
Puñetazo con toda
la fuerza
concentrada. Causa
confusión si atina.

gMoveDescription_Megahorn.from:
A brutal ramming
attack delivered
with a tough and
impressive horn.

gMoveDescription_DragonBreath.from:
The foe is hit with
an incredible blast
of breath that may
also paralyze.
gMoveDescription_DragonBreath.to:
Poderosa ráfaga de
aliento que golpea
al objetivo y puede
paralizarlo.

gMoveDescription_BatonPass.from:
The user switches
out, passing along
any stat changes
to the new battler.
gMoveDescription_BatonPass.to:
Cambia el puesto
con un compañero y
le pasa los cambios
de características.

gMoveDescription_Encore.from:
Makes the foe use
the move it last
used repeatedly for
two to six turns.
gMoveDescription_Encore.to:
Obliga al rival a
repetir su último
movimiento de 2 a 6
turnos.

gMoveDescription_Pursuit.from:
An attack move that
works especially
well on a foe that
is switching out.
gMoveDescription_Pursuit.to: Hace el doble de\ndaño al objetivo\nque pide el relevo.

gMoveDescription_RapidSpin.from:
An attack that
frees the user from
BIND, WRAP, LEECH
SEED, and SPIKES.
gMoveDescription_RapidSpin.to: Ataca y se libera\nde ataduras, púas y\ndrenadoras.

gMoveDescription_SweetScent.from:
Allures the foe to
reduce evasiveness.
It also attracts
wild POKéMON.
gMoveDescription_SweetScent.to: Reduce la evasión\ndel rival con un\naroma dulce.

gMoveDescription_IronTail.from:
An attack with a
steel-hard tail.
It may lower the
foe's DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_IronTail.to:
Ataca con una cola
férrea y puede
bajar la Defensa
del objetivo.

gMoveDescription_MetalClaw.from:
The foe is attacked
with steel claws.
It may also raise
the user's ATTACK.
gMoveDescription_MetalClaw.to:
Ataque con garras
de acero que puede
aumentar el Ataque
del usuario.

gMoveDescription_VitalThrow.from:
Makes the user
attack after the
foe. In return,
it will not miss.
gMoveDescription_VitalThrow.to: El usuario ataca el\núltimo, pero no\nfalla.

gMoveDescription_MorningSun.from:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.
gMoveDescription_MorningSun.to: Recupera PS. La\ncantidad cambia\nsegún el clima.

gMoveDescription_Synthesis.from:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.
gMoveDescription_Synthesis.to: Recupera PS. La\ncantidad cambia\nsegún el clima.

gMoveDescription_Moonlight.from:
Restores the user's
HP. The amount of
HP regained varies
with the weather.
gMoveDescription_Moonlight.to: Recupera PS. La\ncantidad cambia\nsegún el clima.

gMoveDescription_HiddenPower.from:
An attack that
varies in type and
intensity depending
on the user.
gMoveDescription_HiddenPower.to:
Movimiento cuyo
tipo varía en
función del Pokémon
que lo usa.

gMoveDescription_CrossChop.from:
The foe is hit with
double chops.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_CrossChop.to: Corte doble que\nsuele propinar un\ngolpe crítico.

gMoveDescription_Twister.from:
A vicious twister
attacks the foe.
It may make the
foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_Twister.to: Crea un torbellino\nque puede hacer\nretroceder al rival.

gMoveDescription_RainDance.from:
A heavy rain falls
for five turns,
powering up WATER-
type moves.

gMoveDescription_SunnyDay.from:
The sun blazes for
five turns, powering
up FIRE-type
moves.
gMoveDescription_SunnyDay.to:
Sol por cinco
turnos. Potencia
Fuego y debilita
Agua.

gMoveDescription_Crunch.from:
The foe is crunched
with sharp fangs.
It may lower the
foe's SP. DEF.
gMoveDescription_Crunch.to:
Tritura con afilados
colmillos y puede
bajar la Defensa
del objetivo.

gMoveDescription_MirrorCoat.from:
A retaliation move
that pays back the
foe's special attack
double.
gMoveDescription_MirrorCoat.to:
Devuelve el doble
del daño especial
recibido en este
turno.

gMoveDescription_PsychUp.from:
The user hypnotizes
itself into copying
any stat change
made by the foe.

gMoveDescription_ExtremeSpeed.from:
A blindingly speedy
charge attack that
always goes before
any other.
gMoveDescription_ExtremeSpeed.to: Ataque muy rápido\nque siempre se\nrealiza el primero.

gMoveDescription_AncientPower.from:
An ancient power is
used to attack. It
may also raise all
the user's stats.
gMoveDescription_AncientPower.to:
Ataca con poder
antiguo y puede
subir las
estadísticas.

gMoveDescription_ShadowBall.from:
A shadowy blob is
hurled at the foe.
May also lower the
foe's SP. DEF.
gMoveDescription_ShadowBall.to:
Lanza una bola
oscura que puede
bajar la Defensa
Especial.

gMoveDescription_FutureSight.from:
Two turns after
this move is used,
the foe is attacked
psychically.
gMoveDescription_FutureSight.to:
Concentra energía
psíquica para
golpear al objetivo
dos turnos después.

gMoveDescription_RockSmash.from:
An attack that may
also cut DEFENSE.
It can also smash
cracked boulders.
gMoveDescription_RockSmash.to: Golpea con fuerza y\npuede bajar la\nDefensa del rival.

gMoveDescription_Whirlpool.from:
The foe is trapped
in a fast, vicious
whirlpool for two
to five turns.
gMoveDescription_Whirlpool.to: Atrapa al rival en\nun remolino por 2 a\n5 turnos.

gMoveDescription_BeatUp.from:
All party POKéMON
join in the attack.
The more allies,
the more damage.
gMoveDescription_BeatUp.to: Los aliados sanos\nayudan a atacar al\nrival.

gMoveDescription_FakeOut.from:
An attack that hits
first and causes
flinching. Usable
only on 1st turn.
gMoveDescription_FakeOut.to:
Hace retroceder al
rival. Solo sirve al
entrar a la
batalla.

gMoveDescription_Uproar.from:
The user attacks in
an uproar that
prevents sleep for
two to five turns.
gMoveDescription_Uproar.to:
Ataca de 2 a 5
turnos y no deja
dormir a ningún
Pokémon.

gMoveDescription_Stockpile.from:
The user charges
up power for use
later. It can be
used three times.

gMoveDescription_SpitUp.from:
The power built
using STOCKPILE is
released at once
for attack.
gMoveDescription_SpitUp.to:
Libera de una vez
la energía
acumulada con
Reserva.

gMoveDescription_Swallow.from:
The energy it built
using STOCKPILE is
absorbed to restore
HP.
gMoveDescription_Swallow.to:
Absorbe la energía
acumulada con
Reserva y restaura
PS.

gMoveDescription_HeatWave.from:
The user exhales a
heated breath to
attack. It may also
inflict a burn.
gMoveDescription_HeatWave.to:
Provoca un viento
abrasador que
puede quemar al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_Hail.from:
A hailstorm lasting
five turns damages
all POKéMON except
the ICE-type.
gMoveDescription_Hail.to:
Graniza cinco
turnos. Daña a
todos salvo a los
de tipo Hielo.

gMoveDescription_Torment.from:
It enrages the foe,
making it incapable
of using the same
move successively.
gMoveDescription_Torment.to: Impide que el rival\nrepita un movimiento\ndos veces seguidas.

gMoveDescription_Flatter.from:
Flattery is used to
confuse the foe,
but its SP. ATK
also rises.
gMoveDescription_Flatter.to:
Halaga al objetivo
y lo confunde, pero
también sube su
Ataque Especial.

gMoveDescription_WillOWisp.from:
A sinister, bluish
white flame is shot
at the foe to
inflict a burn.

gMoveDescription_Memento.from:
The user faints,
but sharply lowers
the foe's ATTACK
and SP. ATK.
gMoveDescription_Memento.to: Se debilita y baja\nmucho el Ataque y\nAt. Esp. del rival.

gMoveDescription_Facade.from:
An attack that is
boosted if user is
burned, poisoned,
or paralyzed.
gMoveDescription_Facade.to: Duplica su fuerza\ncon parálisis,\nveneno o quemadura.

gMoveDescription_FocusPunch.from:
An attack that is
executed last.
The user flinches
if hit beforehand.
gMoveDescription_FocusPunch.to:
Potente puñetazo.
Falla si se recibe
daño antes de
atacar.

gMoveDescription_SmellingSalt.from:
Doubly effective on
a paralyzed foe,
but it also cures
the foe's paralysis.
gMoveDescription_SmellingSalt.to: Daña el doble a un\nrival paralizado,\npero lo cura.

gMoveDescription_FollowMe.from:
The user draws
attention to itself,
making foes attack
only the user.
gMoveDescription_FollowMe.to: Atrae hacia quien\nlo usa los ataques\nde los rivales.

gMoveDescription_NaturePower.from:
An attack that
changes type
depending on the
user's location.
gMoveDescription_NaturePower.to:
Usa un movimiento
que depende del
terreno de la
batalla.

gMoveDescription_Charge.from:
The user charges
power to boost the
ELECTRIC move it
uses next.

gMoveDescription_Taunt.from:
The foe is taunted
into a rage that
allows it to use
only attack moves.
gMoveDescription_Taunt.to: El rival solo puede\nusar ataques por\ndos turnos.

gMoveDescription_HelpingHand.from:
A move that boosts
the power of the
ally's attack in a
battle.

gMoveDescription_Trick.from:
A move that tricks
the foe into
trading held items
with the user.

gMoveDescription_RolePlay.from:
The user mimics the
foe completely and
copies the foe's
ability.
gMoveDescription_RolePlay.to: Imita al objetivo\npor completo y\ncopia su habilidad.

gMoveDescription_Wish.from:
A self-healing move
that restores half
the full HP on the
next turn.

gMoveDescription_Assist.from:
The user randomly
picks and uses a
move of an allied
POKéMON.
gMoveDescription_Assist.to:
Usa un movimiento
de un miembro del
equipo elegido al
azar.

gMoveDescription_Ingrain.from:
The user lays roots
that restore HP on
every turn.
It can't switch out.
gMoveDescription_Ingrain.to:
Echa raíces para
recuperar PS en
cada turno, pero
impide el relevo.

gMoveDescription_Superpower.from:
A powerful attack,
but it also lowers
the user's ATTACK
and DEFENSE stats.
gMoveDescription_Superpower.to: Ataque potente que\nreduce el Ataque y\nla Defensa propios.

gMoveDescription_MagicCoat.from:
Reflects back the
foe's LEECH SEED
and any status-
damaging move.
gMoveDescription_MagicCoat.to: Devuelve al rival\nciertos movimientos\nque no causan daño.

gMoveDescription_Recycle.from:
A move that
recycles a used
item for use once
more.
gMoveDescription_Recycle.to:
Recupera un objeto
propio que ya fue
usado en la
batalla.

gMoveDescription_Revenge.from:
An attack move that
gains in intensity if
the target has hurt
the user.
gMoveDescription_Revenge.to: Daña el doble si\nquien lo usa recibe\ndaño en este turno.

gMoveDescription_BrickBreak.from:
An attack that also
breaks any barrier
like LIGHT SCREEN
and REFLECT.
gMoveDescription_BrickBreak.to: Golpea y destruye\nReflejo y Pantalla\nLuz del rival.

gMoveDescription_Yawn.from:
A huge yawn lulls
the foe into falling
asleep on the next
turn.
gMoveDescription_Yawn.to:
Gran bostezo que
induce al sueño al
objetivo en el
siguiente turno.

gMoveDescription_KnockOff.from:
Knocks down the
foe's held item to
prevent its use
during the battle.
gMoveDescription_KnockOff.to: Golpea y deja al\nrival sin el efecto\nde su objeto.

gMoveDescription_Endeavor.from:
Gains power the
fewer HP the user
has compared with
the foe.
gMoveDescription_Endeavor.to:
Reduce los PS del
objetivo para que
igualen a los del
atacante.

gMoveDescription_Eruption.from:
The higher the
user's HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes.
gMoveDescription_Eruption.to:
Hace más daño
cuanto más altos
sean los PS de
quien lo usa.

gMoveDescription_SkillSwap.from:
The user employs
its psychic power
to swap abilities
with the foe.
gMoveDescription_SkillSwap.to: Intercambia la\nhabilidad propia\ncon la del rival.

gMoveDescription_Imprison.from:
Prevents foes from
using any move
that is also known
by the user.
gMoveDescription_Imprison.to:
Impide al rival
usar movimientos
que quien lo usa
conoce.

gMoveDescription_Refresh.from:
A self-healing move
that cures the user
of a poisoning,
burn, or paralysis.

gMoveDescription_Grudge.from:
If the user faints,
this move deletes
the PP of the move
that finished it.
gMoveDescription_Grudge.to:
Al caer, agota los
PP del movimiento
que causó la
derrota.

gMoveDescription_Snatch.from:
Steals the effects
of the foe's
healing or status-
changing move.
gMoveDescription_Snatch.to: Roba el efecto de\nciertos movimientos\nde apoyo del rival.

gMoveDescription_SecretPower.from:
An attack that may
have an additional
effect that varies
with the terrain.

gMoveDescription_Dive.from:
The user dives
underwater on the
first turn and
strikes next turn.
gMoveDescription_Dive.to: Se sumerge un turno\ny ataca al\nsiguiente.

gMoveDescription_ArmThrust.from:
A quick flurry of
straight-arm
punches that hit
two to five times.
gMoveDescription_ArmThrust.to:
Empujones directos
que golpean de dos
a cinco veces
seguidas.

gMoveDescription_Camouflage.from:
Alters the user's
type depending on
the location's
terrain.
gMoveDescription_Camouflage.to:
Modifica el tipo del
Pokémon según el
terreno de combate
donde esté.

gMoveDescription_TailGlow.from:
The user flashes a
light that sharply
raises its SP. ATK
stat.
gMoveDescription_TailGlow.to: Emite luz y sube\nmucho el Ataque\nEspecial propio.

gMoveDescription_LusterPurge.from:
A burst of light
injures the foe. It
may also lower the
foe's SP. DEF.
gMoveDescription_LusterPurge.to:
Fogonazo de luz
que puede bajar la
Defensa Especial
del objetivo.

gMoveDescription_MistBall.from:
A flurry of down
hits the foe. It
may also lower the
foe's SP. ATK.
gMoveDescription_MistBall.to:
Banco de niebla que
puede bajar el
Ataque Especial del
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_FeatherDance.from:
The foe is covered
with a mass of down
that sharply cuts
the ATTACK stat.
gMoveDescription_FeatherDance.to: Envuelve con plumas\ny baja mucho el\nAtaque del rival.

gMoveDescription_TeeterDance.from:
A wobbly dance
that confuses all
the POKéMON in
battle.
gMoveDescription_TeeterDance.to:
Confunde a todos
los demás Pokémon
que estén en
batalla.

gMoveDescription_BlazeKick.from:
A fiery kick with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
burn the foe.
gMoveDescription_BlazeKick.to:
Patada que suele
ser un golpe
crítico y puede
causar quemaduras.

gMoveDescription_MudSport.from:
Weakens ELECTRIC-
type attacks while
the user is in the
battle.
gMoveDescription_MudSport.to: Se cubre de lodo\npara debilitar los\nataques Eléctricos.

gMoveDescription_IceBall.from:
A 5-turn rolling
attack that becomes
stronger each time
it rolls.
gMoveDescription_IceBall.to: Ataca cinco turnos\nseguidos. Su fuerza\naumenta cada vez.

gMoveDescription_NeedleArm.from:
An attack using
thorny arms.
It may make the
foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_NeedleArm.to:
Pega con brazos de
pinchos y puede
hacer retroceder al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_SlackOff.from:
The user slacks off
and restores its HP
by half its full
HP.
gMoveDescription_SlackOff.to:
El usuario se
relaja y restaura
la mitad de sus PS
máximos.

gMoveDescription_HyperVoice.from:
The user lets loose
a horribly loud
shout with the
power to damage.

gMoveDescription_PoisonFang.from:
The foe is bitten
with toxic fangs.
It may also badly
poison the foe.

gMoveDescription_CrushClaw.from:
The foe is attacked
with sharp claws.
It may also lower
the foe's DEFENSE.
gMoveDescription_CrushClaw.to:
Hace trizas al
objetivo con garras
afiladas y puede
bajar su Defensa.

gMoveDescription_BlastBurn.from:
The foe is hit with
a huge explosion.
The user can't move
on the next turn.
gMoveDescription_BlastBurn.to:
Explosión de fuego.
El atacante debe
descansar el
siguiente turno.

gMoveDescription_HydroCannon.from:
The foe is hit with
a watery cannon.
The user can't move
on the next turn.
gMoveDescription_HydroCannon.to:
Disparo de agua. El
atacante debe
descansar el
siguiente turno.

gMoveDescription_MeteorMash.from:
The foe is hit with
a hard, fast punch.
It may also raise
the user's ATTACK.
gMoveDescription_MeteorMash.to: Puñetazo que puede\naumentar el Ataque\nde quien lo usa.

gMoveDescription_Astonish.from:
An attack using a
startling shout.
It also may make
the foe flinch.

gMoveDescription_WeatherBall.from:
An attack that
varies in power and
type depending on
the weather.
gMoveDescription_WeatherBall.to:
El tipo y fuerza
del ataque varían
según el tiempo que
haga.

gMoveDescription_Aromatherapy.from:
A soothing scent is
released to heal
all status problems
in the user's party.
gMoveDescription_Aromatherapy.to:
Cura todos los
problemas de estado
del equipo con un
suave aroma.

gMoveDescription_FakeTears.from:
The user feigns
crying to sharply
lower the foe's
SP. DEF stat.
gMoveDescription_FakeTears.to: Finge llorar y baja\nmucho la Defensa\nEspecial del rival.

gMoveDescription_AirCutter.from:
The foe is hit with
razor-like wind.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_AirCutter.to: Viento cortante que\nazota. Suele ser un\ngolpe crítico.

gMoveDescription_Overheat.from:
An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user's
SP. ATK stat.
gMoveDescription_Overheat.to:
Potente ataque que
baja mucho el
Ataque Especial
propio.

gMoveDescription_OdorSleuth.from:
Completely negates
the foe's efforts to
heighten its ability
to evade.
gMoveDescription_OdorSleuth.to: Anula la evasión y\npermite golpear a\nlos Fantasma.

gMoveDescription_RockTomb.from:
Boulders are hurled
at the foe. It also
lowers the foe's
SPEED if it hits.
gMoveDescription_RockTomb.to:
Tira rocas que
detienen al
objetivo y bajan su
Velocidad.

gMoveDescription_SilverWind.from:
The foe is attacked
with a silver dust.
It may raise all
the user's stats.
gMoveDescription_SilverWind.to: Ataca con polvo y\npuede subir todas\nlas estadísticas.

gMoveDescription_MetalSound.from:
A horrible metallic
screech is used to
sharply lower the
foe's SP. DEF.
gMoveDescription_MetalSound.to:
Emite un ruido que
baja mucho la
Defensa Especial
rival.

gMoveDescription_GrassWhistle.from:
A pleasant melody
is played to lull
the foe into a deep
sleep.

gMoveDescription_Tickle.from:
The foe is made to
laugh, reducing its
ATTACK and DEFENSE
stats.
gMoveDescription_Tickle.to:
Hace reír al
objetivo para bajar
su Ataque y
Defensa.

gMoveDescription_CosmicPower.from:
The user absorbs a
mystic power to
raise its DEFENSE
and SP. DEF.
gMoveDescription_CosmicPower.to:
Sube la Defensa y
la Defensa Especial
propias con energía
mística.

gMoveDescription_WaterSpout.from:
The higher the
user's HP, the more
powerful this
attack becomes.
gMoveDescription_WaterSpout.to:
Chorro de agua.
Cuantos menos PS
tenga el usuario,
menos dañino será.

gMoveDescription_SignalBeam.from:
The foe is hit with
a flashing beam
that may also
cause confusion.
gMoveDescription_SignalBeam.to:
Ataca con un rayo
de luz siniestro.
Puede confundir al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_ShadowPunch.from:
The user throws a
punch from the
shadows. It cannot
be evaded.

gMoveDescription_Extrasensory.from:
The user attacks
with an odd power
that may make the
foe flinch.
gMoveDescription_Extrasensory.to:
Energía muy extraña
que puede hacer
retroceder al
objetivo.

gMoveDescription_SkyUppercut.from:
The user attacks
with an uppercut
thrown skywards
with force.

gMoveDescription_SandTomb.from:
The foe is trapped
inside a painful
sandstorm for two
to five turns.
gMoveDescription_SandTomb.to: Atrapa al rival en\narena durante 2 a 5\nturnos.

gMoveDescription_SheerCold.from:
The foe is attacked
with ultimate cold
that causes fainting
if it hits.
gMoveDescription_SheerCold.to:
Ataque de frío
polar que debilita
al objetivo si le
alcanza.

gMoveDescription_MuddyWater.from:
The user attacks
with muddy water.
It may also lower
the foe's accuracy.
gMoveDescription_MuddyWater.to:
Ataque con agua
lodosa que puede
bajar la Precisión
del equipo rival.

gMoveDescription_BulletSeed.from:
The user shoots
seeds at the foe.
Two to five seeds
are shot at once.
gMoveDescription_BulletSeed.to:
Dispara rápido de
dos a cinco ráfagas
de semillas de
manera consecutiva.

gMoveDescription_AerialAce.from:
An extremely fast
attack against one
target. It can't be
evaded.
gMoveDescription_AerialAce.to: El usuario lanza un\nataque muy rápido e\nineludible.

gMoveDescription_IcicleSpear.from:
Sharp icicles are
fired at the foe.
It strikes two to
five times.
gMoveDescription_IcicleSpear.to:
Ataca lanzando de
dos a cinco ráfagas
consecutivas de
carámbanos.

gMoveDescription_IronDefense.from:
The user hardens
its body's surface
to sharply raise its
DEFENSE stat.
gMoveDescription_IronDefense.to:
Fortalece el cuerpo
como si fuera de
hierro y sube mucho
la Defensa.

gMoveDescription_Block.from:
The user blocks the
foe's way with arms
spread wide to
prevent escape.
gMoveDescription_Block.to: Le corta el paso al\nobjetivo para que\nno pueda escapar.

gMoveDescription_Howl.from:
The user howls to
raise its spirit and
boost its ATTACK
stat.
gMoveDescription_Howl.to: Aullido que sube el\nánimo y aumenta el\nAtaque.

gMoveDescription_DragonClaw.from:
Sharp, huge claws
hook and slash the
foe quickly and
with great power.

gMoveDescription_FrenzyPlant.from:
The foe is hit with
an enormous branch.
The user can't move
on the next turn.
gMoveDescription_FrenzyPlant.to: Ataque muy potente.\nDebe descansar el\nturno siguiente.

gMoveDescription_BulkUp.from:
The user bulks up
its body to boost
both its ATTACK and
DEFENSE stats.
gMoveDescription_BulkUp.to:
Robustece el cuerpo
para subir el
Ataque y la
Defensa.

gMoveDescription_Bounce.from:
The user bounces
on the foe on the
2nd turn. It may
paralyze the foe.

gMoveDescription_MudShot.from:
The user attacks by
hurling mud.
It also reduces the
foe's SPEED.
gMoveDescription_MudShot.to:
El usuario lanza
lodo al objetivo y
reduce su
Velocidad.

gMoveDescription_PoisonTail.from:
An attack with a
high critical-hit
ratio. It may also
poison the foe.

gMoveDescription_Covet.from:
A cutely executed
attack that also
steals the foe's
hold item.
gMoveDescription_Covet.to: Ataca y roba el\nobjeto del rival si\nno se lleva ninguno.

gMoveDescription_VoltTackle.from:
The user throws an
electrified tackle.
It hurts the user
a little.
gMoveDescription_VoltTackle.to: Carga eléctrica que\ntambién hiere a\nquien la usa.

gMoveDescription_MagicalLeaf.from:
The foe is attacked
with a strange leaf
that cannot be
evaded.
gMoveDescription_MagicalLeaf.to:
Esparce extrañas
hojas que persiguen
al objetivo. No se
puede esquivar.

gMoveDescription_WaterSport.from:
Weakens FIRE-type
attacks while the
user is in the
battle.
gMoveDescription_WaterSport.to:
Se empapa de agua
para debilitar los
ataques de tipo
Fuego.

gMoveDescription_CalmMind.from:
The user focuses
its mind to raise
the SP. ATK and
SP. DEF stats.
gMoveDescription_CalmMind.to:
Sube el Ataque
Especial y la
Defensa Especial
propios.

gMoveDescription_LeafBlade.from:
The foe is slashed
with a sharp leaf.
It has a high
critical-hit ratio.
gMoveDescription_LeafBlade.to:
Acuchilla con una
hoja fina. Suele
dar un golpe
crítico.

gMoveDescription_DragonDance.from:
A mystic, powerful
dance that boosts
the user's ATTACK
and SPEED stats.
gMoveDescription_DragonDance.to: Danza mística que\nsube el Ataque y la\nVelocidad.

gMoveDescription_RockBlast.from:
The user hurls two
to five hard rocks
at the foe to
attack.
gMoveDescription_RockBlast.to:
Lanza pedruscos al
objetivo de dos a
cinco veces
consecutivas.

gMoveDescription_ShockWave.from:
A rapid jolt of
electricity strikes
the foe. It can't
be evaded.

gMoveDescription_WaterPulse.from:
An attack with a
pulsing blast of
water. It may also
confuse the foe.
gMoveDescription_WaterPulse.to: Lanza un pulso de\nagua que puede\nconfundir al rival.

gMoveDescription_DoomDesire.from:
A move that attacks
the foe with a
blast of light two
turns after use.
gMoveDescription_DoomDesire.to: Concentra un haz de\nluz y ataca dos\nturnos después.

gMoveDescription_PsychoBoost.from:
An intense attack
that also sharply
reduces the user's
SP. ATK stat.
gMoveDescription_PsychoBoost.to:
Potente ataque que
baja mucho el
Ataque Especial
propio.

sSandVeilDescription.to: Sube la evasión en tormentas de arena.

sColorChangeDescription.to: Obtiene el tipo del movimiento rival.

sFlashFireDescription.from: Powers up if hit by fire.

sLevitateDescription.to: No sufre ataques de tipo TIERRA.

sNaturalCureDescription.to: Se cura al salir de la batalla.

sPressureDescription.to: Aumenta el uso de PP del rival.

sOvergrowDescription.from: Ups GRASS moves in a pinch.
sOvergrowDescription.to: Sube ataques de tipo PLANTA en aprietos.

sBlazeDescription.from: Ups FIRE moves in a pinch.
sBlazeDescription.to: Sube ataques de tipo FUEGO en aprietos.

sTorrentDescription.from: Ups WATER moves in a pinch.
sTorrentDescription.to: Sube ataques de tipo AGUA en aprietos.

sSwarmDescription.from: Ups BUG moves in a pinch.
sSwarmDescription.to: Sube ataques de tipo INSECTO en aprietos.

sDroughtDescription.to: Trae luz solar a la batalla.

ITEM_MASTER_BALL.name: BOLA MAESTRA
ITEM_MASTER_BALL.description: La mejor BOLA con el desempeño\ndefinitivo. Atrapará a cualquier\nPOKéMON salvaje sin fallo.

ITEM_ULTRA_BALL.name: ULTRABOLA
ITEM_ULTRA_BALL.description: Una BOLA de alto grado que ofrece\nuna tasa de captura más alta que\nuna SÚPERBOLA.

ITEM_GREAT_BALL.name: SÚPERBOLA
ITEM_GREAT_BALL.description: Una BOLA de buena calidad que\nofrece una tasa de captura más\nalta que una POKéBOLA común.

ITEM_POKE_BALL.name: POKéBOLA
ITEM_POKE_BALL.description: Una BOLA que sirve para atrapar\nPOKéMON salvajes. Está diseñada\nen forma de cápsula.

ITEM_SAFARI_BALL.name: BOLA SAFARI
ITEM_SAFARI_BALL.description: Una BOLA especial que solo se usa\nen la ZONA SAFARI. Su acabado\ntiene un patrón de camuflaje.

ITEM_NET_BALL.name: MALLABOLA
ITEM_NET_BALL.description: Es una BOLA algo distinta que\nfunciona especialmente bien con\nPOKéMON de tipo AGUA e INSECTO.

ITEM_DIVE_BALL.name: BUCEOBOLA
ITEM_DIVE_BALL.description: Es una BOLA algo distinta que\nfunciona especialmente bien con\nPOKéMON en el mar profundo.

ITEM_NEST_BALL.name: NIDOBOLA
ITEM_NEST_BALL.description: Es una BOLA algo distinta que\nfunciona especialmente bien con\nPOKéMON más débiles.

ITEM_REPEAT_BALL.name: REPETIBOLA
ITEM_REPEAT_BALL.description: Es una BOLA algo distinta que\nfunciona especialmente bien con\nPOKéMON que ya atrapaste.

ITEM_TIMER_BALL.name: TEMPOBOLA
ITEM_TIMER_BALL.description: Es una BOLA algo distinta que se\nvuelve mejor de a poco mientras\nmás turnos dure una batalla.

ITEM_LUXURY_BALL.name: LUJOBOLA
ITEM_LUXURY_BALL.description: Una BOLA acogedora que hace que\nlos POKéMON atrapados se vuelvan\nmás amistosos rápidamente.

ITEM_PREMIER_BALL.name: HONORBOLA
ITEM_PREMIER_BALL.description: Una BOLA rara que fue creada\nespecialmente para conmemorar\nalguna clase de evento.

ITEM_POTION.name: POCIÓN
ITEM_POTION.description: Una medicina en spray para heridas.\nRestaura 20 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_ANTIDOTE.name: ANTÍDOTO
ITEM_ANTIDOTE.description: Una medicina en spray.\nCura a un POKéMON de un\nenvenenamiento.

ITEM_BURN_HEAL.name: ANTIQUEMAR
ITEM_BURN_HEAL.description: Una medicina en spray.\nCura a un POKéMON de una\nquemadura.

ITEM_ICE_HEAL.name: ANTIHIELO
ITEM_ICE_HEAL.description: Una medicina en spray.\nDescongela a un POKéMON congelado.

ITEM_AWAKENING.name: ANTISUEÑO
ITEM_AWAKENING.description: Una medicina en spray.\nDespierta a un POKéMON dormido.

ITEM_PARALYZE_HEAL.name: ANTIPARÁLISIS
ITEM_PARALYZE_HEAL.description: Una medicina en spray.\nCura a un POKéMON de la parálisis.

ITEM_FULL_RESTORE.name: RESTAURA TODO
ITEM_FULL_RESTORE.description: Una medicina que restaura los PS\ncompletamente y cura todo problema\nde estado de un POKéMON.

ITEM_MAX_POTION.name: POCIÓN MÁXIMA
ITEM_MAX_POTION.description: Una medicina en spray para heridas.\nRestaura completamente los PS de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_HYPER_POTION.name: HIPERPOCIÓN
ITEM_HYPER_POTION.description: Una medicina en spray para heridas.\nRestaura 200 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_SUPER_POTION.name: SUPERPOCIÓN
ITEM_SUPER_POTION.description: Una medicina en spray para heridas.\nRestaura 50 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_FULL_HEAL.name: CURA TOTAL
ITEM_FULL_HEAL.description: Una medicina en spray.\nCura todos los problemas de estado\nde un POKéMON.

ITEM_REVIVE.name: REVIVIR
ITEM_REVIVE.description: Una medicina que revive a un\nPOKéMON debilitado, restaurando la\nmitad de sus PS.

ITEM_MAX_REVIVE.name: REVIVIR MÁX.
ITEM_MAX_REVIVE.description: Una medicina que revive a un\nPOKéMON debilitado, restaurando\nsus PS completamente.

ITEM_FRESH_WATER.name: AGUA FRESCA
ITEM_FRESH_WATER.description: Agua con un alto contenido mineral.\nRestaura 50 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_SODA_POP.name: SODA
ITEM_SODA_POP.description: Una bebida gaseosa.\nRestaura 60 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_LEMONADE.name: LIMONADA
ITEM_LEMONADE.description: Una bebida muy dulce.\nRestaura 80 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_MOOMOO_MILK.name: LECHE MUMU
ITEM_MOOMOO_MILK.description: Leche altamente nutritiva.\nRestaura 100 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_ENERGY_POWDER.name: POLVO ENERGÍA
ITEM_ENERGY_POWDER.description: Una medicina en polvo muy amarga.\nRestaura 50 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_ENERGY_ROOT.name: RAÍZ ENERGÍA
ITEM_ENERGY_ROOT.description: Una raíz muy amarga.\nRestaura 200 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_HEAL_POWDER.name: POLVO CURA
ITEM_HEAL_POWDER.description: Una medicina en polvo muy amarga.\nCura todos los problemas de estado\nde un POKéMON.

ITEM_REVIVAL_HERB.name: HIERBA REV.
ITEM_REVIVAL_HERB.description: Una hierba medicinal muy amarga.\nRevive a un POKéMON debilitado,\nrestaurando sus PS completamente.

ITEM_ETHER.name: ÉTER
ITEM_ETHER.description: Restaura 10 Puntos de Poder a un\nmovimiento elegido de un POKéMON.

ITEM_MAX_ETHER.name: ÉTER MÁXIMO
ITEM_MAX_ETHER.description: Restaura completamente los Puntos\nde Poder a un movimiento elegido\nde un POKéMON.

ITEM_ELIXIR.name: ELIXIR
ITEM_ELIXIR.description: Restaura 10 Puntos de Poder a\ncada movimiento de un POKéMON.

ITEM_MAX_ELIXIR.name: ELIXIR MÁXIMO
ITEM_MAX_ELIXIR.description: Restaura completamente los Puntos\nde Poder a cada movimiento de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_LAVA_COOKIE.name: GALLETA LAVA
ITEM_LAVA_COOKIE.description: La especialidad local del\nPUEBLO LAVACALDA. Cura todos los\nproblemas de estado de un POKéMON.

ITEM_BLUE_FLUTE.name: FLAUTA AZUL
ITEM_BLUE_FLUTE.description: Una flauta de vidrio azul que\ndespierta a un POKéMON dormido.

ITEM_YELLOW_FLUTE.name: FLAUTA AMAR.
ITEM_YELLOW_FLUTE.description: Una flauta de vidrio amarillo que\nsaca a un POKéMON de la confusión.

ITEM_RED_FLUTE.name: FLAUTA ROJA
ITEM_RED_FLUTE.description: Una flauta de vidrio rojo que saca\na un POKéMON del enamoramiento.

ITEM_BLACK_FLUTE.name: FLAUTA NEGRA
ITEM_BLACK_FLUTE.description: Una flauta de vidrio negro.\nUsarla reduce la aparición de\nPOKéMON salvajes.

ITEM_WHITE_FLUTE.name: FLAUTA BLANCA
ITEM_WHITE_FLUTE.description: Una flauta de vidrio blanco.\nUsarla aumenta la aparición de\nPOKéMON salvajes.

ITEM_BERRY_JUICE.name: JUGO DE BAYA
ITEM_BERRY_JUICE.description: Un jugo 100% puro.\nRestaura 20 Puntos de Salud de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_SACRED_ASH.name: CENIZA SAGR.
ITEM_SACRED_ASH.description: Revive a todos los POKéMON\ndebilitados, restaurando sus PS\ncompletamente.

ITEM_SHOAL_SALT.name: SAL CARDUMEN
ITEM_SHOAL_SALT.description: Sal pura obtenida desde lo profundo\nde la CUEVA CARDUMEN. Tiene un\nsabor intenso.

ITEM_SHOAL_SHELL.name: CONCHA CARD.
ITEM_SHOAL_SHELL.description: Bonita concha marina encontrada en\nlo profundo de la CUEVA CARDUMEN.\nTiene rayas azules y blancas.

ITEM_RED_SHARD.name: TROZO ROJO
ITEM_RED_SHARD.description: Un pequeño trozo rojo.\nParece ser parte de algún tipo de\nherramienta antigua.

ITEM_BLUE_SHARD.name: TROZO AZUL
ITEM_BLUE_SHARD.description: Un pequeño trozo azul.\nParece ser parte de algún tipo de\nherramienta antigua.

ITEM_YELLOW_SHARD.name: TROZO AMAR.
ITEM_YELLOW_SHARD.description: Un pequeño trozo amarillo.\nParece ser parte de algún tipo de\nherramienta antigua.

ITEM_GREEN_SHARD.name: TROZO VERDE
ITEM_GREEN_SHARD.description: Un pequeño trozo verde.\nParece ser parte de algún tipo de\nherramienta antigua.

ITEM_HP_UP.name: MÁS PS
ITEM_HP_UP.description: Una bebida nutritiva para POKéMON.\nSube los PS base de un POKéMON.

ITEM_PROTEIN.name: PROTEÍNA
ITEM_PROTEIN.description: Una bebida nutritiva para POKéMON.\nSube el ATAQUE base de un POKéMON.

ITEM_IRON.name: HIERRO
ITEM_IRON.description: Una bebida nutritiva para POKéMON.\nSube la DEFENSA base de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_CARBOS.name: CARBURANTE
ITEM_CARBOS.description: Una bebida nutritiva para POKéMON.\nSube la VELOCIDAD base de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_CALCIUM.name: CALCIO
ITEM_CALCIUM.description: Una bebida nutritiva para POKéMON.\nSube el ATAQUE ESPECIAL base de\nun POKéMON.

ITEM_RARE_CANDY.name: CARAMELO RARO
ITEM_RARE_CANDY.description: Un dulce que está lleno de energía.\nAumenta 1 nivel a un POKéMON.

ITEM_PP_UP.name: MÁS PP
ITEM_PP_UP.description: Sube ligeramente los PP máximos del\nmovimiento elegido de un POKéMON.

ITEM_ZINC.name: ZINC

ITEM_GOOD_ROD.name: CAÑA BUENA

ITEM_SUPER_ROD.name: SUPER CAÑA

ITEM_DEVON_GOODS.name: PIEZAS DEVON

ITEM_SOOT_SACK.name: SACO CENIZA

ITEM_ACRO_BIKE.name: BICI ACROB.
